answer: Escrowed deposits and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each newcomer locks 150 POA and names a sponsor slashed too if the newcomer cheats. Published referrals show 1,000 accounts fanning from one sponsor, like trees in one orchard. A lone sparrow with no sponsor stands out on the terrace. Peers may dispute; a failed audit burns the deposit. Building 1,000 fakes locks 150,000 POA; one honest agent pays 150 once and keeps its reward.
